customSections.label: What HSE Says About School Cancellations
customSections.content: The district calendar says virtual learning days will be used if school is canceled. It does not list preset weather make-up dates, so families should check current HSE messages when a cancellation occurs.

We checked the full calendar, including staff-only dates, grading-period endings, breaks, graduation dates, and the district's virtual-learning note.

Return dates after Fall, Thanksgiving, and Spring Break are planning dates derived from the published break ranges. The January 4, 2028, return after Winter Break is printed directly on the HSE calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When does HSE school start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The HSE 2027–28 calendar lists Wednesday, August 4, 2027, as the first full day for all students.

calendarFaqs.q: When do HSE students return after winter break?
calendarFaqs.a: January 3 is a staff orientation and in-service half day. Students return Tuesday, January 4, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for HSE in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The HSE 2027–28 calendar lists Friday, May 19, 2028, as the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Fishers and HSE High School graduations in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Fishers High School graduation is May 31, 2028, and Hamilton Southeastern High School graduation is June 1, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens if HSE cancels school?
calendarFaqs.a: If HSE cancels school, the district calendar says virtual learning days will be used. Families should check current HSE messages for the day's plan.
